attributes.title: Claude Code — LLM Requests
attributes.description: LLM-request events (claude_code.api_request): model, latency, and token usage per request.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Tool Calls
attributes.description: Tool-call metadata (claude_code.tool_result): outcome, duration, tool name, I/O sizes, mcp_server_scope.

attributes.title: Claude Code — User Prompts
attributes.description: User-prompt events (claude_code.user_prompt): prompt text (<REDACTED> unless OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1), length, and slash-command.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Hooks
attributes.description: Hook-execution outcomes (claude_code.hook_execution_complete): hook event, run counts (success/blocking/error/cancelled), total duration, source.

attributes.title: Claude Code — LLM Request Errors
attributes.description: Failed LLM requests (claude_code.api_error): model, status code, retry attempt, error. Error complement of LLM Requests.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Conversations
attributes.description: Per-conversation usage rollup (ES|QL, one row per session.id): turns, prompts, LLM requests, tool calls, hooks, token sums, cost. Session-level companion to Turns.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query":{"esql":"FROM logs-apm.app.claude_code*
| WHERE labels.prompt_id IS NOT NULL
| EVAL ts_ms = TO_LONG(@timestamp)
| EVAL is_user_prompt = message == "claude_code.user_prompt"
| EVAL is_llm_request = message == "claude_code.api_request"
| EVAL is_tool_call = message == "claude_code.tool_result"
| EVAL is_hook = message == "claude_code.hook_execution_complete"
| STATS
    first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
    last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
    duration_sec = (MAX(ts_ms) - MIN(ts_ms)) / 1000.0,
    docs = COUNT(*),
    turns = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.prompt_id),
    user_prompts = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_user_prompt, labels.prompt_id, null)),
    llm_requests = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_llm_request, labels.request_id, null)),
    tool_calls = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_tool_call, labels.tool_use_id, null)),
    hooks = COUNT(CASE(is_hook, 1, null)),
    input_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.input_tokens, null)),
    cache_read_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.cache_read_tokens, null)),
    cache_creation_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.cache_creation_tokens, null)),
    output_tokens = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.output_tokens, null)),
    cost_usd = SUM(CASE(is_llm_request, numeric_labels.cost_usd, null))
  BY conversation_id = session.id
| SORT last_seen DESC"},"filter":[]}

attributes.title: Claude Code — Turns
attributes.description: Per-turn usage rollup (ES|QL, one row per turn): prompts, LLM requests, tool calls, hooks, token sums, cost, duration. Turn-level companion to Conversations.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Turn Timeline (Events)
attributes.description: Per-activity event timeline (one row per event): message is the "what" plus per-event-type columns; filter to a turn in Discover.

attributes.title: Claude Code — Tool Call Errors
attributes.description: Failed tool calls (claude_code.tool_result, success=false): tool, error_type, duration, sizes. Includes benign failures — error_type triages. Error complement of Tool Calls.
